title: Seymour and Jeanette send for John Williams's combo for $75 a week
summary: Seymour and Jeanette were the only black act on the Keith and Pantages circuits. They wired for John's combo at $75 each, a fortune compared to $25.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well then eventually the Buz Harris show, the tour just came to an end?
Well, I tell you, John Williams got an offer to go with Seymour and Jeanette.
While you were still working with Buz?
Yes, and it had really petered out.

One of the greatest acts on - I'll tell you, during that period you know how prejudiced they were. They wouldn't dare have a black person on Keith, Pantages, that. But Seymour and Jeanette were the only black team on Keith circuit, Pantages, and all - and Bill Bojangles. They only booked those two people. So John Williams received a wire that they needed a combo because Seymour did a strutting act and what not. He was very good at it but he had a bad heart, so he thought that if he got a small combo that would help him along. So he wired John and said he'd be making $75. Woo, that was like making a thousand dollars a week, you know! So we joined -
